notes:
{助|たす}け is the noun form derived from the verb {助|たす}ける (to help, to rescue).

Common expressions:
- {助|たす}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to seek help)
- {助|たす}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call for help)
- {助|たす}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧ (to borrow help from someone)
- {助|たす}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to be of help)
- {助|たす}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{伸|の}べる→差し伸べる：07265_sashinoberu⟧ (to extend a helping hand)
